raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
K3 defers image preprocessing to the owning vision-DP rank, but that rank still materializes and encodes its whole shard at once. Large requests can retain a normalized pixel buffer and encoder workspace together.

Add an opt-in `SGLANG_K3_VISION_MAX_FRAMES_PER_BATCH` limit. Each owner preprocesses and encodes complete temporal items in bounded groups, then uses the existing embedding gather and order reconstruction. `0` keeps the current one-batch path; final embeddings and language-model KV still grow with the request. This builds on main's deferred preprocessing, rather than adding a new video input format or duplicating #35325.

Validate the frame budget against the complete shared grid list before owner assignment or encoding. Otherwise an oversized item can make its owner raise while an empty peer enters the single-image broadcast. The regression covers both ranks; valid requests retain the existing batching and order.

## Validation

The earlier CPU mRoPE helper and synthetic K3 routing checks validate temporal grouping, owner-only callbacks, underfilled/empty ranks and ordering on `8fa0c9d0`. They use a synthetic tower and are not real CUDA preprocessing or tower-numerics evidence.

At `4978d435`, the follow-up executes the actual K3 `get_image_feature` method, DP helper and new registered regression bodies on CPU. The old source rejects on the owner but reaches broadcast on the empty peer; the patch makes both reject before any collective. The unchanged helper regression suite also passes. Torch 2.14.1 is real CPU; runtime configuration, collective groups and media-item objects are fixtures, with startup imports isolated. This does not execute real collectives or the full SGLang package.

At `0176d36`, a new registered CPU test runs two real Gloo ranks: both reject an invalid budget, then the same ranks finish a single-item broadcast and an uneven all-gather. Locally, unchanged K3 method/helper bodies were loaded from source with fixture configuration and media objects (macOS, CPU Torch 2.14.1). It fails on pre-guard `8fa0c9d0` with a 10-second Gloo receive timeout and passes on the fix. The upstream test uses normal K3 imports; that full-package path remains unverified locally because `datasets` is missing. This adds CPU collective liveness/recovery evidence, not CUDA/NCCL or full-service validation.

At `f384bc57`, a source-isolated run on **2× A100 PCIe 40GB** used the unchanged K3 method and six DP helper bodies with real CUDA tensors and NCCL (PyTorch 2.5.1+cu124, NCCL 2.21.5). Single-image broadcast with an empty peer and unequal padded all-gather passed exact shape/value checks on both ranks, for parent `8fa0c9d0` and the current head. Oversized/zero-budget cases rejected on both fixed ranks before collective/tower/materialization; the parent's empty-rank collective attempts were intercepted before NCCL, then both variants completed healthy cases in the same initialized group. The tower, media and group adapters are fixtures. [GPU run and scope](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46103#issuecomment-6519517985).

A separate normal-package run at `f384bc57` constructs the real encoder-only K3 wrapper, vision tower and projector with a tiny configuration and deterministic random weights (1,952 parameters), using two real SGLang WORLD/model-parallel Gloo ranks. The current complete source archive was checked against all 11,229 Git blobs. Unlimited and frame-bounded outputs match exactly for an empty-peer broadcast and an uneven gather with temporal pooling/spatial interpolation; both ranks reject invalid temporal budgets and complete healthy requests afterward. This uses CPU Torch 2.14.1 on macOS, native RoPE/SDPA, already prepared tensor items and explicit test topology. The unused message-queue broadcaster is disabled via its normal option, and upstream's macOS compatibility layer remains active. It does not qualify CUDA tower numerics, pretrained weights, media preprocessing, CUDA IPC or the production launcher.

Scoped Ruff, formatting, isort and diff checks pass. The cookbook documents the limit. Current-head docs-site validation, normal-package CUDA preprocessing/tower numerics, peak memory and end-to-end serving remain unverified. No performance claim.

Prepared with Codex assistance.

 No preset has a full serving round on final weights; the constants derive from measured single- and dual-node rounds plus a 64-GPU sweep. Validate throughput and accuracy on your workload before committing a fleet.
 </Note>
+
+
+## Bound rank-local vision batches
+
+Set `SGLANG_K3_VISION_MAX_FRAMES_PER_BATCH` to a positive frame budget to split
+preprocessing and vision encoding on each owning rank. For example, `8` keeps
+at most eight frames in a local encoding batch. A temporal item remains intact;
+a budget smaller than one item's frame count is rejected.
+
+The default `0` preserves one encoding batch per owner. Item order, temporal
+pooling and the existing vision-DP gather remain unchanged. This bounds local
+preprocessing and encoder temporaries; the final embeddings and language-model
+KV cache still grow with the request. It does not enable a new input format.

+"""Vision-DP validation must not leave an empty peer in a collective."""
+
+import math
+import time
+import unittest
+from datetime import timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
+from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=35, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _GlooVisionGroup:
+    """Use real CPU collectives through the vision helper's group interface."""
+
+    def broadcast(self, tensor, src):
+        dist.broadcast(tensor, src=src)
+
+    def all_gather(self, tensor, dim):
+        gathered = [torch.empty_like(tensor) for _ in range(dist.get_world_size())]
+        dist.all_gather(gathered, tensor)
+        return torch.cat(gathered, dim=dim)
+
+
+class _CPUVisionTower(torch.nn.Module):
+    device = torch.device("cpu")
+    merge_kernel_size = (2, 2)
+    patch_size = 2
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.config = SimpleNamespace(hidden_size=2)
+        self.patch_embed = SimpleNamespace(
+            proj=SimpleNamespace(weight=torch.empty(1, dtype=torch.float32))
+        )
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    def forward(self, pixels, *, grid_hw, grid_thw_list, max_seqlen):
+        self.calls += 1
+        assert grid_hw.tolist() == grid_thw_list
+        assert max_seqlen == max(math.prod(grid) for grid in grid_thw_list)
+        outputs = []
+        offset = 0
+        for temporal, height, width in grid_thw_list:
+            # Like K3's tower, pool time away and preserve the packed 2x2 axes.
+            value = pixels[offset, 0].item()
+            outputs.append(torch.full((height * width // 4, 4, 2), value))
+            offset += temporal * height * width
+        assert offset == len(pixels)
+        return outputs
+
+
+def _run_vision_rank(rank, init_file):
+    torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    # Keep optional CUDA kernels out of a test that only runs CPU control flow.
+    maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+    from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+    from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Modality, MultimodalDataItem
+    from sglang.srt.models.kimi_k3 import KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        "gloo",
+        init_method=Path(init_file).as_uri(),
+        rank=rank,
+        world_size=2,
+        timeout=timedelta(seconds=10),
+    )
+    try:
+        model = KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration.__new__(KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration)
+        torch.nn.Module.__init__(model)
+        model.use_data_parallel = True
+        model.vision_tower = _CPUVisionTower()
+        model.mm_projector = torch.nn.Identity()
+
+        def item(grid, value):
+            return MultimodalDataItem(
+                modality=Modality.IMAGE,
+                feature=torch.full((math.prod(grid), 2), value),
+                model_specific_data={"image_grid_thw": torch.tensor([grid])},
+            )
+
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_K3_VISION_MAX_FRAMES_PER_BATCH.override(3),
+            get_parallel().override(
+                attn_tp_size=2, attn_tp_rank=rank, attn_tp_group=_GlooVisionGroup()
+            ),
+        ):
+            try:
+                model.get_image_feature([item([4, 2, 2], 5.0)])
+            except ValueError as exc:
+                message = str(exc)
+                assert "temporal item does not fit" in message
+            else:
+                raise AssertionError("oversized temporal item was accepted")
+
+            messages = [None, None]
+            dist.all_gather_object(messages, message)
+            assert messages == [message, message]
+            assert model.vision_tower.calls == 0
+
+            # The same ranks must still finish a broadcast with one empty peer.
+            actual = model.get_image_feature([item([2, 2, 2], 7.0)])
+            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, torch.full((1, 4, 2), 7.0))
+
+            # Uneven rank outputs exercise padding, a real gather and order repair.
+            actual = model.get_image_feature(
+                [
+                    item([3, 2, 2], 11.0),
+                    item([1, 4, 2], 13.0),
+                    item([2, 2, 2], 17.0),
+                ]
+            )
+            expected = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    torch.full((1, 4, 2), 11.0),
+                    torch.full((2, 4, 2), 13.0),
+                    torch.full((1, 4, 2), 17.0),
+                ]
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
+            dist.barrier()
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+class TestKimiK3VisionDPGloo(CustomTestCase):
+    @unittest.skipUnless(dist.is_available() and dist.is_gloo_available(), "needs Gloo")
+    def test_invalid_budget_then_valid_requests_finish_on_all_ranks(self):
+        context = mp.get_context("spawn")
+        processes = []
+        with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            try:
+                for rank in range(2):
+                    process = context.Process(
+                        target=_run_vision_rank,
+                        args=(rank, str(Path(directory) / "gloo-init")),
+                    )
+                    process.start()
+                    processes.append(process)
+                deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
+                for process in processes:
+                    process.join(max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+                self.assertFalse(
+                    any(process.is_alive() for process in processes),
+                    "a vision-DP rank did not finish within 60 seconds",
+                )
+                self.assertEqual([process.exitcode for process in processes], [0, 0])
+            finally:
+                for process in processes:
+                    if process.is_alive():
+                        process.terminate()
+                for process in processes:
+                    process.join(5)
+                    if process.is_alive():
+                        process.kill()
+                        process.join(5)
+                    process.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
